Kerala Election Commissioner Appointment Sparks Internal Congress Dissent

The appointment of Seshadrinath as the new Kerala State Election Commissioner has led to internal dissent within the ruling Congress party. Critics within the party and the CPI(M) have raised concerns about the nominee's alleged ties to the RSS. The Kerala Governor has given assent to the appointment, despite the controversy.
